'''Denis Rygelli''', known as "Reggie", was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] serving with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Having repaired everything from [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Rygelli decided that he wanted to do more for the Rebellion, and attended a briefing headed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] alongside [[Carns Capra]], [[Ben Spax]] and [[Trinna Orani]], on the procedures for establishing a Rebel cell structure on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A good man at heart, he was nervous about his choice to switch from technical work to field work.
